review: UpdateDynamicBones calls Verlet integration, constraints and transform application.
ShouldTickMultiThread delegates to ShouldTickGeneral, which checks Behaviour.enabled.
Thread result application checks Behaviour.enabled before writing transforms.
ResetBoneTransforms uses each particle initial local position/rotation.
ResetParticlesPosition resets previous/current particle positions and owner previous position.
ApplyParticlesToTransforms is not idempotent: live no-contact reapply diagnostic produced excessive rotation. Custom contacts run before the single apply call.
Legacy Verlet last-step argument is -1.0, verified from the executable constant; mode 3 receives the fixed timestep.
Barbara and Nahida tested arrays have no native colliders. Additional body capsules and cloth segment contacts are approximate, not mesh collision.
Opt-in mesh diagnostics clone and bake into an owned Mesh; readability is changed only on that copy, which is destroyed in a finally guard. No renderer sharedMesh replacement occurs.

Reversible subtree translation diagnostics found zero influence from the original 24 controlled skirt bones on several central front vertices. The omitted SkirtF CF B01-B04 chain is now owned and restored explicitly.
Supplemental chain bending uses the reset reference shape, not the already deformed integration result. Native arrays retain their original stiffness and are applied once.
